texts.NIV84: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.
texts.KJV: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
texts.NKJV: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
texts.NASB95: Now may our God and Father Himself and Jesus our Lord direct our way to you;
texts.DRB: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
texts.ESV: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you,

texts.NIV84: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.
texts.KJV: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
texts.NKJV: And may the Lord make you increase and abound in love to one another and to all, just as we do to you,
texts.NASB95: and may the Lord cause you to increase and abound in love for one another, and for all people, just as we also do for you;
texts.DRB: And may the Lord multiply you, and make you abound in charity towards one another, and towards all men: as we do also towards you,
texts.ESV: and may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, as we do for you,

texts.NIV84: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.
texts.KJV: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
texts.NKJV: so that He may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.
texts.NASB95: so that He may establish your hearts without blame in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.
texts.DRB: To confirm your hearts without blame, in holiness, before God and our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, with all his saints. Amen.
texts.ESV: so that he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

texts.NIV84: Finally, brothers, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.
texts.KJV: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
texts.NKJV: Finally then, brethren, we urge and exhort in the Lord Jesus that you should abound more and more, just as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God;
texts.NASB95: Finally then, brethren, we request and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us instruction as to how you ought to walk and please God (just as you actually do walk), that you excel still more.
texts.DRB: For the rest therefore, brethren, we pray and beseech you in the Lord Jesus, that as you have received from us, how you ought to walk, and to please God, so also you would walk, that you may abound the more.
texts.ESV: Finally, then, brothers, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, just as you are doing, that you do so more and more.

texts.NIV84: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
texts.KJV: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
texts.NKJV: for you know what commandments we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
texts.NASB95: For you know what commandments we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
texts.DRB: For you know what precepts I have given to you by the Lord Jesus.
texts.ESV: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

texts.DRB: For this is the will of God, your sanctification; that you should abstain from fornication;
texts.ESV: For this is the will of God, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality;

texts.KJV: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

texts.NASB95: that each of you know how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
texts.DRB: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour:

texts.NASB95: not in lustful passion, like the Gentiles who do not know God;
texts.DRB: Not in the passion of lust, like the Gentiles that know not God:
texts.ESV: not in the passion of lust like the Gentiles who do not know God;

texts.NIV84: and that in this matter no one should wrong his brother or take advantage of him. The Lord will punish men for all such sins, as we have already told you and warned you.

texts.NKJV: that no one should take advantage of and defraud his brother in this matter, because the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also forewarned you and testified.
texts.NASB95: and that no man transgress and defraud his brother in the matter because the Lord is the avenger in all these things, just as we also told you before and solemnly warned you.
texts.DRB: And that no man overreach, nor circumvent his brother in business: because the Lord is the avenger of all these things, as we have told you before, and have testified.

texts.NIV84: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

texts.NASB95: For God has not called us for the purpose of impurity, but in sanctification.
texts.DRB: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto sanctification.
texts.ESV: For God has not called us for impurity, but in holiness.

texts.NIV84: Therefore, he who rejects this instruction does not reject man but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
texts.KJV: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

texts.NIV84: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

texts.NIV84: Brothers, we do not want you to be ignorant about those who fall asleep, or to grieve like the rest of men, who have no hope.

texts.ESV: But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about those who are asleep, that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope.

texts.NIV84: We believe that Jesus died and rose again and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

texts.NASB95: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with Him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
texts.DRB: For if we believe that Jesus died, and rose again; even so them who have slept through Jesus, will God bring with him.
texts.ESV: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so, through Jesus, God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep.

texts.NIV84: According to the Lord's own word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left till the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.
texts.KJV: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
texts.NKJV: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who are asleep.
texts.NASB95: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord, will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
texts.DRB: For this we say unto you in the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who remain unto the coming of the Lord, shall not prevent them who have slept.
texts.ESV: For this we declare to you by a word from the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will not precede those who have fallen asleep.

texts.NIV84: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
texts.KJV: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
texts.NKJV: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.
texts.NASB95: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.
texts.DRB: For the Lord himself shall come down from heaven with commandment, and with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God: and the dead who are in Christ, shall rise first.
texts.ESV: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a cry of command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the sound of the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.

texts.NIV84: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.
texts.KJV: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

texts.ESV: Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord.

texts.NASB95: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
texts.DRB: Wherefore, comfort ye one another with these words.
texts.ESV: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

texts.NIV84: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming--not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
texts.KJV: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
texts.NKJV: For the law, having a shadow of the good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with these same sacrifices, which they offer continually year by year, make those who approach perfect.
texts.NASB95: For the Law, since it has only a shadow of the good things to come and not the very form of things, can never, by the same sacrifices which they offer continually year by year, make perfect those who draw near.
texts.DRB: For the law having a shadow of the good things to come, not the very image of the things; by the selfsame sacrifices which they offer continually every year, can never make the comers thereunto perfect:
texts.ESV: For since the law has but a shadow of the good things to come instead of the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices that are continually offered every year, make perfect those who draw near.

texts.NIV84: If it could, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.

texts.NASB95: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have had consciousness of sins?

texts.ESV: Otherwise, would they not have ceased to be offered, since the worshipers, having once been cleansed, would no longer have any consciousness of sins?

texts.NIV84: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,
texts.KJV: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
texts.NKJV: by a new and living way which He consecrated for us, through the veil, that is, His flesh,
texts.NASB95: by a new and living way which He inaugurated for us through the veil, that is, His flesh,
texts.DRB: A new and living way which he hath dedicated for us through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
texts.ESV: by the new and living way that he opened for us through the curtain, that is, through his flesh,

texts.NIV84: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
texts.KJV: And having an high priest over the house of God;
texts.NKJV: and having a High Priest over the house of God,
texts.NASB95: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
texts.DRB: And a high priest over the house of God:
texts.ESV: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

texts.NIV84: let us draw near to God with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and having our bodies washed with pure water.
texts.KJV: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
texts.NKJV: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
texts.NASB95: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
texts.DRB: Let us draw near with a true heart in fulness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with clean water.
texts.ESV: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

texts.NIV84: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.
texts.KJV: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
texts.NKJV: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.
texts.NASB95: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful;
texts.DRB: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering (for he is faithful that hath promised),
texts.ESV: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for he who promised is faithful.

texts.NIV84: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds.
texts.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
texts.NKJV: And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works,
texts.NASB95: and let us consider how to stimulate one another to love and good deeds,
texts.DRB: And let us consider one another, to provoke unto charity and to good works:
texts.ESV: And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works,

texts.NIV84: Let us not give up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but let us encourage one another--and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
texts.KJV: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
texts.NKJV: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
texts.NASB95: not forsaking our own assembling together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another; and all the more as you see the day drawing near.
texts.DRB: Not forsaking our assembly, as some are accustomed; but comforting one another, and so much the more as you see the day approaching.
texts.ESV: not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.

texts.NIV84: If we deliberately keep on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left,
texts.KJV: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
texts.NKJV: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
texts.NASB95: For if we go on sinning willfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,
texts.DRB: For if we sin wilfully after having the knowledge of the truth, there is now left no sacrifice for sins,
texts.ESV: For if we go on sinning deliberately after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,

texts.NIV84: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.
texts.KJV: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
texts.NKJV: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and fiery indignation which will devour the adversaries.
texts.NASB95: but a terrifying expectation of judgment and the fury of a fire which will consume the adversaries.
texts.DRB: But a certain dreadful expectation of judgment, and the rage of a fire which shall consume the adversaries.
texts.ESV: but a fearful expectation of judgment, and a fury of fire that will consume the adversaries.

texts.NIV84: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
texts.KJV: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
texts.NKJV: Anyone who has rejected Moses’ law dies without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
texts.NASB95: Anyone who has set aside the Law of Moses dies without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
texts.DRB: A man making void the law of Moses, dieth without any mercy under two or three witnesses:
texts.ESV: Anyone who has set aside the law of Moses dies without mercy on the evidence of two or three witnesses.

texts.NIV84: How much more severely do you think a man deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God under foot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?
texts.KJV: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
texts.NKJV: Of how much worse punishment, do you suppose, will he be thought worthy who has trampled the Son of God underfoot, counted the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified a common thing, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
texts.NASB95: How much severer punishment do you think he will deserve who has trampled under foot the Son of God, and has regarded as unclean the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
texts.DRB: How much more, do you think he deserveth worse punishments, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath esteemed the blood of the testament unclean, by which he was sanctified, and hath offered an affront to the Spirit of grace?
texts.ESV: How much worse punishment, do you think, will be deserved by the one who has trampled underfoot the Son of God, and has profaned the blood of the covenant by which he was sanctified, and has outraged the Spirit of grace?

texts.NIV84: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."
texts.KJV: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
texts.NKJV: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine, I will repay,” says the Lord. And again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
texts.NASB95: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine, I will repay.” And again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
texts.DRB: For we know him that hath said: Vengeance belongeth to me, and I will repay. And again: The Lord shall judge his people.
texts.ESV: For we know him who said, “Vengeance is mine; I will repay.” And again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

texts.NIV84: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
texts.KJV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
texts.NKJV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
texts.NASB95: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
texts.DRB: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
texts.ESV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

texts.NIV84: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you stood your ground in a great contest in the face of suffering.
texts.KJV: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
texts.NKJV: But recall the former days in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
texts.NASB95: But remember the former days, when, after being enlightened, you endured a great conflict of sufferings,
texts.DRB: But call to mind the former days, wherein, being illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions.
texts.ESV: But recall the former days when, after you were enlightened, you endured a hard struggle with sufferings,

texts.NIV84: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.
texts.KJV: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
texts.NKJV: partly while you were made a spectacle both by reproaches and tribulations, and partly while you became companions of those who were so treated;
texts.NASB95: partly by being made a public spectacle through reproaches and tribulations, and partly by becoming sharers with those who were so treated.
texts.DRB: And on the one hand indeed, by reproaches and tribulations, were made a gazingstock; and on the other, became companions of them that were used in such sort.
texts.ESV: sometimes being publicly exposed to reproach and affliction, and sometimes being partners with those so treated.

texts.NIV84: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.
texts.KJV: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
texts.NKJV: for you had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your goods, knowing that you have a better and an enduring possession for yourselves in heaven.
texts.NASB95: For you showed sympathy to the prisoners and accepted joyfully the seizure of your property, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and a lasting one.
texts.DRB: For you both had compassion on them that were in bands, and took with joy the being stripped of your own goods, knowing that you have a better and a lasting substance.
texts.ESV: For you had compassion on those in prison, and you joyfully accepted the plundering of your property, since you knew that you yourselves had a better possession and an abiding one.

texts.NIV84: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.
texts.KJV: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
texts.NKJV: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.
texts.NASB95: Therefore, do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
texts.DRB: Do not therefore lose your confidence, which hath a great reward.
texts.ESV: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.

texts.NIV84: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.
texts.KJV: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
texts.NKJV: For you have need of endurance, so that after you have done the will of God, you may receive the promise:
texts.NASB95: For you have need of endurance, so that when you have done the will of God, you may receive what was promised.
texts.DRB: For patience is necessary for you; that, doing the will of God, you may receive the promise.
texts.ESV: For you have need of endurance, so that when you have done the will of God you may receive what is promised.

texts.NIV84: For in just a very little while, "He who is coming will come and will not delay.
texts.KJV: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
texts.NKJV:
“For yet a little while,
And He who is coming will come and will not tarry.
texts.NASB95:
For yet in a very little while,
He who is coming will come, and will not delay.
texts.DRB: For yet a little and a very little while, and he that is to come, will come, and will not delay.

texts.NIV84: But my righteous one will live by faith. And if he shrinks back, I will not be pleased with him."
texts.KJV: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
texts.NASB95:
But My righteous one shall live by faith;
And if he shrinks back, My soul has no pleasure in him.
texts.DRB: But my just man liveth by faith; but if he withdraw himself, he shall not please my soul.
texts.ESV:
but my righteous one shall live by faith,
    and if he shrinks back,
my soul has no pleasure in him.”

texts.NIV84: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who believe and are saved.
texts.KJV: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
texts.NKJV: But we are not of those who draw back to perdition, but of those who believe to the saving of the soul.
texts.NASB95: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the preserving of the soul.
texts.DRB: But we are not the children of withdrawing unto perdition, but of faith to the saving of the soul.
texts.ESV: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
